editorial.blurb: Ethiopian Cottage Restaurant welcomes newcomers and regulars alike to a calm, soothing space where traditional Ethiopian dishes shine with quality ingredients and genuine hospitality.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the 2-person sampler platters (meat or vegan) to experience about 5 typical dishes at once; the thinner injera here won't fill you up too fast, and the kik alecha and cabbage are standouts.

topDishes.note: regulars return for these; about 5 items showcasing Ethiopian flavors
especially delicious and a reviewer favorite
